utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, did you hear? They finally fixed that pothole on Elm Street!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, that's great news! It was about time they fixed it. Have you been to the community garden lately? I finally got that fence repaired.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's wonderful about the garden fence! I noticed the new flowers they planted there—looks so cheerful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday works for me. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll bring my old toaster. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: See you then!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, how's the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, it's this Saturday, right? I want to make sure we're on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, it's this Saturday—I've got it marked on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'll make sure Jules is there to help with the swing chain repair.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I'll see if Cleo has the right chain from the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We should check with Sam first; he's inventorying the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'll check the tool inventory to see what we have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, Cleo's already sorting through donated tools, so we should have plenty.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll still take a look to see if we're missing anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Vik! Sorry, I forgot what we were talking about. Repair drive? Something about fixing things?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, the repair drive! Rosa will be there, you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Rosa? Oh, yes, she's good with tools. That's great she's coming.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Eli. What's the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I've got the sign-up sheet ready. We're meeting Saturday at 9 AM sharp.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Saturday at 9. I'll be there on time this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I heard about the repair drive. I've got some spare tools if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's really kind of you, Gus! I could definitely use some tools. What do you have?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a good set of wrenches and a cordless drill you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, can you tell me more about the repair drive? I want to make sure I understand the details before we start.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, let me think... I'm a bit fuzzy on the details, actually.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, do you have any notes or could you check the message again? We need the exact details to proceed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got the hammers and screwdrivers sorted, but I could use some help with the wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Noah's been meaning to fix his fence—maybe he has some wrenches we can borrow!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good idea! I'll set aside the wrenches we already have while we check with Noah.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Did Sam say anything about missing tools?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, I haven't heard Sam mention missing tools. Have you checked the garage?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet. I saw Cleo sorting donated tools, maybe she found something.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe we can do Saturday morning for the porch steps? Dane offered to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, the repair drive is happening on Sunday at the community center, but if you and Dane want to tackle the porch steps separately on Saturday, that could work too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good. What time Saturday morning works for you and Dane?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Who's going to actually do the repairs? We have plenty of tools and supplies, but not that many skilled hands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I've already offered to fix the garden fence, and we can ask around for more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good, but we need a solid schedule so we don't have gaps in coverage.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Do we know if the tool inventory matches what was donated?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Rosa will be at the repair drive, you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that's good. But I wonder if the inventory Sam checked matches the donations Cleo is sorting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Jules, what's the situation with the repair drive? I want to make sure I have all the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana! It's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. I'm bringing my old toaster—do you have anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday 10 to 4 at the community center, right? I think I have a wobbly lamp that could use some love. I'll bring it along!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, did you hear? They finally fixed that pothole on Elm Street! No more dodging that crater.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that's good. I've been meaning to check on that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, you can stop worrying about it now. It's smooth as glass.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you bringing your tools to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, got the toolbox ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you bring any screwdrivers and wrenches, or just the general toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal! I'm so glad you're here. The repair drive is this Sunday at the community center, and we could really use your help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, Rosa. What time does it start, and do you need me to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It kicks off at 10 AM. If you have a hammer and screwdrivers, bring those along—they'll come in handy!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday morning would work for me, if that's good for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday morning? Yeah, that sounds fine. Just remind me the day before, I tend to forget things.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I'll give you a nudge Friday evening. Thanks for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, I'm rallying folks for the repair drive—I heard Noah's been wanting to fix his fence, think you could give him a hand?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can spare a few hours this weekend. Just let me know when.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Ira! I'll let Noah know you're in. How about Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I hope I remembered to bring that toolbox I promised.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'll go check our tool inventory to make sure we have everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Good idea, Sam. I just hope I actually brought that toolbox—it's been a blur of a morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got all the wrenches sorted by size now, just need to find a place for the hammers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh good, Sam's checking the tool inventory, maybe we can find a spot for the hammers near there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I'll set the hammers aside until Sam tells me where to put them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, still on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, just wanted to make sure.
